data.title: 守岸人 · 灯塔下的潮汐泳装
data.description: 【黑海岸浅湾·傍晚】守岸人穿着蓝白泳装坐在浅湾岩石上，白色长发与轻纱披肩被海风吹开；她把捡到的发光水母形贝壳放在掌心，抬头看向镜头，像第一次真正享受海水的温度。
data.location: shallow cove beneath the Black Shores lighthouse
data.action: 浅湾岩石上捧发光水母形贝壳，第一次真正享受海水温度
data.lighting: soft evening glow on translucent water
data.promptProse: Seated on a shallow-bay rock, the Shorekeeper turns a luminous jellyfish-shaped shell in her palm before looking toward the viewer. Her blue-and-white coastal swimsuit, light shoulder wrap and shell bracelet remain clear beside windblown blue hair and bare feet. The horizontal medium view includes translucent water over the lower rocks. Soft evening glow reflects across wave edges, while the shell lights her fingers and the shaded underside of her wrist.
